"""Replayable brush trajectory for the fixed 樂 exemplar.
The brush lays overlapping horizontal ribbons, keeping an unmarked light
contact between ribbons in each of the four connected calligraphic regions.
"""
import argparse,json,math,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session

OUT=Path('/app/output')

def make_plan(im, spacing=5, width_px=8, inset_px=1.5):
    target=np.array(im)[...,:3].mean(2)<100
    lab,n=ndi.label(target)
    # centres safe for the entire ribbon's perpendicular width; a horizontal
    # footprint may touch the endpoint, so inset longitudinally by 1.5 pixels.
    safe=ndi.binary_erosion(target,structure=np.ones((width_px+1,3)),border_value=0)
    plan=[]
    for comp in range(1,n+1):
        region=lab==comp
        if region.sum()<100: continue
        ys,xs=np.where(region)
        rows=range(ys.min()+width_px//2,ys.max()-width_px//2+1,spacing)
        runs=[]
        for v in rows:
            row=safe[v]&region[v]
            changes=np.diff(np.r_[False,row,False].astype(int))
            for a,b in zip(np.where(changes==1)[0],np.where(changes==-1)[0]):
                if b-a<13: continue
                runs.append([float(a)+inset_px,float(b-1)-inset_px,float(v)])
        plan.append(runs)
    return target,plan

def execute(s,plan,width_px=8,speed=.025,blank_speed=.04):
    p=s.primitives()
    p['move_tip']((-.1,.15,.055),speed=.12,settle=8)
    p['move_tip']((-.1,.15,.026),speed=.015,settle=8)
    p['move_tip']((-.1,.15,.055),speed=.06,settle=6)
    px=s.geo.px_m
    width=width_px*px
    press=(width+.00030)/1.187
    # The arm settles about 0.093 mm above its IK target under gravity.
    z_full=.020-press-.000093
    z_blank=.01980
    drag=(1.075*press*100+0.138)/100
    stats=[]
    for k,runs in enumerate(plan):
        if not runs: continue
        x,y=s.geo.px_to_world(runs[0][0]+drag/px,runs[0][2])
        p['move_tip']((x,y,.032),speed=.12,settle=10)
        p['move_tip']((x,y,z_blank),speed=.015,settle=10)
        for i,(a,b,v) in enumerate(runs):
            start=a+drag/px
            x,y=s.geo.px_to_world(start,v)
            # At the blank press depth Width(z)=0, although contact continues.
            p['move_tip']((x,y,z_blank),speed=blank_speed,settle=5)
            # Initialise horizontal travel before developing brush width.
            xa,ya=s.geo.px_to_world(start-.8,v)
            p['move_tip']((xa,ya,z_blank),speed=.01,settle=3)
            p['move_tip']((x,y,z_full),speed=.005,settle=7)
            xe,ye=s.geo.px_to_world(b,v)
            p['move_tip']((xe,ye,z_full),speed=speed,settle=7)
            p['move_tip']((xe,ye,z_blank),speed=.005,settle=8)
            if i%50==0: print('region',k+1,'ribbon',i,'/',len(runs),'steps',s.n_steps,flush=True)
        p['move_tip']((xe,ye,.032),speed=.02,settle=10)
        stats.append({'region':k+1,'ribbons':len(runs),'steps':s.n_steps})
    p['move_tip']((-.1,0,.075),speed=.1,settle=20)
    return stats

def local_metrics(ink,target):
    got=ink>=.5
    inter=(got&target).sum(); union=(got|target).sum()
    dist=ndi.distance_transform_edt(~target)
    return {'iou':float(inter/union),'precision':float(inter/max(1,got.sum())),
            'recall':float(inter/target.sum()),'stray':float((got&(dist>1/.22185987)).sum()/target.sum())}

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--spacing',type=int,default=5);ap.add_argument('--width',type=int,default=8);ap.add_argument('--inset',type=float,default=1.5);ap.add_argument('--speed',type=float,default=.025);ap.add_argument('--score',action='store_true');args=ap.parse_args()
    t=time.time(); OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    target,plan=make_plan(Image.open('/app/target.png'),args.spacing,args.width,args.inset)
    print('ribbons',list(map(len,plan)),flush=True)
    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False);s.reset();s.record_start()
    stats=execute(s,plan,args.width,args.speed)
    actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,OUT/'trajectory.npz',meta={'ribbons':stats,'args':vars(args)})
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT/'canvas.png'); np.save(OUT/'ink.npy',s.ink())
    met=local_metrics(s.ink(),target);print('local',met,'steps',s.n_steps,'seconds',time.time()-t,'contacts',len(s.strokes()),flush=True)
    np.savez_compressed(OUT/'samples.npz',**{f'stroke_{i}':st['samples'] for i,st in enumerate(s.strokes())})
    print('stats',s.painter.stats,flush=True)
    (OUT/'local.json').write_text(json.dumps(met,indent=2))
    if args.score:
        score=s.status(); print('SCORER',json.dumps(score),flush=True);(OUT/'score.json').write_text(json.dumps(score,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
